summary: Improve warehouse flow, inventory accuracy, and safety with practical exercises. Explore the five-day operations course and outline.
lede: Warehouse operations training helps supervisors, inventory controllers and logistics coordinators manage the movement and control of goods. It covers process mapping, receiving and location controls, inventory classification and cycle counting, plus picking, dispatch checks and basic performance review. Participants practise creating operational checklists and improvement plans, while exploring warehouse management system workflows, barcode and RFID data capture, and safety review principles at an operational overview level.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people responsible for receiving, inventory, storage, order fulfilment, dispatch, or warehouse safety who need practical methods for improving day-to-day control.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace or logistics operations is helpful. No coding or prior WMS configuration experience is required. Advanced digital topics are introduced at an operational overview level; exercises focus on process decisions and sample records.
